text: Stefan's housewarming is sometime next week, he'll confirm the day. New flat in Leyton, top floor no lift. Bring something that isn't wine, he's off it.
remind me to text Claire the morning of her first day at the bank, she's dreading the commute
Vanessa and her husband Rory celebrating 10 yrs married end of the month. Dinner at the place they had their first date. She wants a proper photo album as a gift, hinted twice.
Elif got the promotion!! Team lead from next month. Send congrats

so um just spoke to Carlos and his engagement party is off because they've decided to wait till after his dad's surgery which is early March apparently, so I should call him the day after the op to see how his dad's doing
Sophie leaving drinks Thurs, she's retiring after 31 years at the council. Collection going round, chip in by Wed.
Seo-yeon - started at the design studio Monday. Loves it so far. Boss is 'intense'. Ask how week two goes.
Pick up dry cleaning, renew car tax before end of the month, book dentist.
Damian's wedding in Porto over the summer, date TBC. He asked if I'd do a reading. I'm saying yes obviously. Need to sort flights once he confirms.
Yusuf nervous about his first day at the hospital tomorrow. Text him good luck that morning.
Lunch w Aleksander. His wife Marta is expecting in Feb. He's v allergic to shellfish fyi. Wants to get into sailing.
Lin's 40th dinner Saturday 7:30 at Dishoom, I'm bringing the cake. Get a card the day before.
Lena said her brother Gintaras just got engaged to his girlfriend of six years. Wedding probably next spring in Vilnius.
Dong handed in his notice, last day is the 14th. Leaving do the night after at the Crown. Don't forget to sign the card.
Pooja's anniversary party got called off, Dev's mum is unwell. Check in on Pooja next week.
Efua - works in procurement now, moved to Croydon, has a greyhound called Biscuit. Vegan.
Rory's retiring at Christmas after 25 years teaching. Kids are throwing him a surprise do the weekend before, keep it quiet.

voice memo. ok so Yara rang about the reunion dinner, it's going to be sometime in early November, she's booking a room at that Italian on the high street and wants numbers by the end of the week. Yasmin's coming down from Leeds for it, and Jun might too if he can get off work. Yara also mentioned she's starting a new job at the museum on the 3rd, curator assistant, she sounded really chuffed. I should reply to her email with my yes and ask about veggie options.
Tobi had his interview at Monzo yesterday. Thinks it went ok, hears back sometime next week.
Anders + Kasia anniversary trip to Lisbon in mid-May, 5 yrs. Kasia secretly wants a nice watch for him lol
must ask Bao how the leaving speech went
Chiara's sister Georgia is getting married in Tuscany, Sept 12. Chiara's maid of honour and stressing about the hen do. Rehearsal dinner the night before.
Yaw - new role as head chef at Ember, started two weeks ago. Long hours, knackered but happy. Remind me to book a table there end of the month.
Rachel invited us to her housewarming on the 22nd. Mariam's coming with me. I'm doing a salad.
Note to self: finish the tax return, gym 3x this week, call the landlord about the boiler.
Stef (Stefan) got made redundant on Friday. Pretty shaken. He has a meeting with HR on Tuesday and then a week after that his notice period ends. Check in Tuesday evening.
Claire & Damian engaged!! Proposed on the beach in Cornwall last weekend. Party at hers sometime next month.
Vanessa's dog Pepper had surgery on her leg Thursday, recovering ok. V is exhausted.
Elif's leaving do went really well apparently, I missed it. Message her tomorrow to say sorry and ask about the new place.
carlos bday next sat, he wants vinyl - maybe that Khruangbin album
Had coffee with Sophie Baker. Her son starts uni in Bristol in Sept, she's a bit emotional about it. Her husband's away on business most of next month.
Seo-yeon's promotion review is the 30th, she's anxious. Text her the night before and then call the day after to see how it went.
Mrs Walsh from next door is having a garden party for her 70th, early June. Lovely woman, collects teapots.
Yusuf and Pooja are moving in together end of the month!! Housewarming afterwards probably.
dinner at Aleksander's tonight, 8pm, bring dessert
Lin said her mum is retiring next month after 40 years nursing. Big family meal planned the weekend after. Lin's organising and a bit overwhelmed.

just got off the phone with Lena, she's been offered the job in Berlin, starts in early March, and her partner Anders is going to follow over the summer once his contract ends. She's excited but nervous about the language. Remind me to send her that German app link, and I need to plan a send-off for her sometime in February.
Dong and his wife renewing their vows on their 20th anniversary, 4 April. Invite in the post.
Efua's first week as a manager. Struggling w one of her reports. I should take her for a drink Friday.
Rory said his daughter's christening is the 2nd, and lunch after at the golf club. Gift: something silver?
Yara's engagement — fiancé is called Jun, lovely guy, works in finance. Wedding sometime in 2028 probs.
Party at Yasmin's for Eid, Sat afternoon. Bring sweets for the kids.
Tobi starts at Monzo on the 6th!! Got the job. Send congratulations and ask him how the first week goes the Friday after.
Kasia was on about her boss leaving at the end of the quarter, she might go for his role. Hasn't decided.

Remind me to get Bao a card for his retirement, and to ask Chiara whether we're chipping in together. His last day is sometime next week, Thursday I think. Afterwards there's a lunch at the Thai place.
Uncle Yaw's 60th dinner was cancelled, he's got covid. Instead family zoom Sunday.
Gintaras moved to Manchester for a new job at the BBC. Supports Man City (ugh). Loves climbing.
Georgia's hen do is the weekend of the 15th in Brighton. I'm going, Rachel's driving us. Need to pay Georgia back for the Airbnb before then.
Mariam passed her probation at the firm today! Permanent from Monday. Celebrating drinks Fri.
Groceries, then pick up Mum's prescription.

spoke to Stefan and Claire about their anniversary they're doing a weekend away end of the month somewhere in the Cotswolds and Stefan asked if I could feed their cat Miso while they're gone. Need to get their spare key the day before
Vanessa doesn't drink, gluten free. Works at the Guardian. Loves pottery.
Elif's husband Carlos is starting his own business in the new year, he's quit the agency. She's worried about money.
Damian's work do the Friday before Christmas, plus ones invited. He asked if I'd come along as his plus one.
Ask Sophie how her daughter's wedding went! It was last Saturday in York.
Dr Ahmed (Pooja's dad) retiring end of the year. Party at their house afterwards, sometime in Jan.
Seo-yeon told me she and Lin broke up. Their anniversary dinner was meant to be next Friday. Call her this weekend.
Jun's leaving for a new job in Tokyo early Feb. Big farewell dinner the week before, Yasmin organising. Remind me to RSVP and ask Jun what he wants as a leaving present, maybe a good travel bag.
Aleksander's firm's summer party is sometime in July, he's on the organising committee and it's eating his evenings.
Yusuf asked me to be best man!!! Wedding is 18 Oct next year. Stag sometime in Sept. Must start a group chat with Tobi and Dong.
